mapper.select: select (select count(*) from biz_hr_employee e where e.del_flag = '0' and e.employee_status in ('0', '1')) as headcount, (select count(*) from biz_hr_entry en where en.del_flag = '0' and year(en.entry_date) = year(curdate())) as entryCount, (select count(*) from biz_hr_leave lv where lv.del_flag = '0' and year(lv.leave_date) = year(curdate())) as leaveCount, (select ifnull(sum(p.gross_salary + ifnull(p.social_insurance,0) + ifnull(p.house_fund,0)), 0) from biz_hr_payslip p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.year_month = (select max(p2.year_month) from biz_hr_payslip p2 where p2.del_flag = '0')) as costAmount, (select ifnull(sum(p.net_salary), 0) from biz_hr_payslip p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.year_month = (select max(p2.year_month) from biz_hr_payslip p2 where p2.del_flag = '0')) as netAmount, (select max(p.year_month) from biz_hr_payslip p where p.del_flag = '0') as latestMonth, (select ifnull(sum(o.overtime_hours), 0) from biz_hr_overtime o where o.del_flag = '0' and year(o.overtime_date) = year(curdate())) as overtimeHours, (select count(*) from biz_hr_certificate c where c.del_flag = '0' and c.valid_to < curdate()) as certExpired

select d.dept_name as name, d.dept_id as deptId, count(e.employee_id) as count, sum(case when e.gender = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as maleCount, sum(case when e.gender = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as femaleCount from sys_dept d join biz_hr_employee e on e.org_id = d.dept_id and e.del_flag = '0' and e.employee_status in ('0', '1') where d.del_flag = '0' group by d.dept_id, d.dept_name order by count desc

select t.month_seq as yearMonth, ifnull(en.cnt, 0) as entryCount, ifnull(lv.cnt, 0) as leaveCount, ifnull(en.cnt, 0) - ifnull(lv.cnt, 0) as count from ( select 1 as month_seq union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5 union select 6 union select 7 union select 8 union select 9 union select 10 union select 11 union select 12 ) t left join ( select month(entry_date) as m, count(*) as cnt from biz_hr_entry where del_flag = '0' and year(entry_date) = #{params.year} group by month(entry_date) ) en on en.m = t.month_seq left join ( select month(leave_date) as m, count(*) as cnt from biz_hr_leave where del_flag = '0' and year(leave_date) = #{params.year} group by month(leave_date) ) lv on lv.m = t.month_seq order by t.month_seq

select d.dept_name as name, d.dept_id as deptId, count(m.monthly_id) as requiredPeople, ifnull(sum(m.attend_days), 0) as attendDays, ifnull(sum(m.actual_days), 0) as count, ifnull(sum(m.late_count), 0) as lateCount, ifnull(sum(m.early_count), 0) as earlyCount, ifnull(sum(m.absent_days), 0) as absentDays, ifnull(sum(m.leave_days), 0) as leaveDays, ifnull(sum(m.overtime_hours), 0) as overtimeHours, ifnull(sum(m.night_shift_count), 0) as nightShiftCount from biz_hr_attendance_monthly m join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = m.dept_id where m.del_flag = '0' and m.year_month = #{yearMonth} group by d.dept_id, d.dept_name order by d.dept_name

select m.year_month as yearMonth, ifnull(sum(m.attend_days), 0) as attendDays, ifnull(sum(m.absent_days), 0) as absentDays, ifnull(sum(m.leave_days), 0) as leaveDays, ifnull(sum(m.overtime_hours), 0) as overtimeHours, ifnull(sum(m.late_count), 0) as lateCount from biz_hr_attendance_monthly m where m.del_flag = '0' and m.year_month like concat(#{params.year}, '%') group by m.year_month order by m.year_month

select p.year_month as yearMonth, ifnull(sum(p.gross_salary), 0) as grossAmount, ifnull(sum(p.social_insurance), 0) as socialAmount, ifnull(sum(p.house_fund), 0) as fundAmount, ifnull(sum(p.income_tax), 0) as taxAmount, ifnull(sum(p.net_salary), 0) as netAmount, ifnull(sum(p.gross_salary + ifnull(p.social_insurance,0) + ifnull(p.house_fund,0)), 0) as costAmount from biz_hr_payslip p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.year_month like concat(#{params.year}, '%') group by p.year_month order by p.year_month

select d.dept_name as name, d.dept_id as deptId, count(p.payslip_id) as count, ifnull(sum(p.gross_salary), 0) as grossAmount, ifnull(sum(p.social_insurance), 0) as socialAmount, ifnull(sum(p.house_fund), 0) as fundAmount, ifnull(sum(p.income_tax), 0) as taxAmount, ifnull(sum(p.net_salary), 0) as netAmount, ifnull(sum(p.gross_salary + ifnull(p.social_insurance,0) + ifnull(p.house_fund,0)), 0) as costAmount from biz_hr_payslip p join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.org_id where p.del_flag = '0' and p.year_month = #{yearMonth} group by d.dept_id, d.dept_name order by costAmount desc
